message: COPY PORTREC (line 40, under FD PORTFOLIO-FILE) names a copybook that is not in the inventory copybook_registry. Left as an unresolved stub; no USES_COPYBOOK or EXPANDS_COPY registered. FD PORTFOLIO-FILE therefore has no record layout.

FD TRANSACTION-FILE (line 32) has no inline 01; its record comes from COPY TRNREC (line 35), whose 01 TRANSACTION-RECORD (SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0014-REC-0001, 152 bytes) is linked by EXPANDS_COPY from the FILE section (SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0072-SEC-0003). It is not registered as a FILE record of this program and does not count in this file's total_bytes.
RECORD KEY PORT-ID (SELECT PORTFOLIO-FILE, line 27) is not declared in the program or in the expanded copybooks TRNREC, ERRHAND, AUDITLOG; it would come from the unresolved copybook PORTREC.

COPY ERRHAND (line 43) and COPY AUDITLOG (line 44) sit directly under the WORKING-STORAGE SECTION with no enclosing 01. Linked by EXPANDS_COPY from section SYS-PORTFOLIO-001-FIL-0072-SEC-0004; their bytes (8+10+370+8+240; 392) count only in the copybooks' own records, not in this file's total_bytes.
